channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: District attorney reopens case of alleged Cornell University 'gang rape'
item.description: Prosecutors in central New York say they are reopening the case of an alleged gang rape at a Cornell University fraternity.

item.title: Nor'easter weakens after deadly Northeast battering
item.description: The nor'easter is weakening and moving slowly northeast from Long Island, New York, to Massachusetts on Monday.

item.title: Congo Ebola outbreak surpasses 8,000 confirmed cases
item.description: Confirmed Ebola cases in Congo have exceeded 8,000 as the country faces a shortage of health workers.

item.title: Iran says Trump must choose between war and diplomacy
item.description: As the war with Iran reaches seven months, Trump tells Axios he expects talks to resume despite neither side signaling a change in demands.
